item.tib: dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgyud kyi de kho na nyid rab tu bstan par byed pa zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel
item.skt: shrI badzra DA ka tan tra s+ya tad t+wa sus+thi ra nA ma pany+dzi kA
item.coloph: dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bka' 'grel de kho na nyid bstan par byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po nor bzangs kyis zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrI 'ga' ya d+ha ra dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba gyi co zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba
